summary.text: Stacy Willoughby is a Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 12-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Brian Burnett (R).
Ballotpedia lists her profession as financial services, and she finished first in the August 4 primary by 46 votes.

paragraphs.text: Stacy Willoughby's Ballotpedia profile lists her career experience as working in financial services.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, her campaign described her as a financial professional, nonprofit president, daughter of a veteran and resident of Washington's 12th Legislative District.
In the August 4, 2026 primary for District 12-Position 1, Willoughby received 13,474 votes (50.0 percent) and Burnett received 13,428 votes (49.9 percent).

Her survey responses name creating good jobs and a strong local economy, housing that is affordable and available in every community, and fully funding public schools alongside vocational and career-connected education as her key messages.
